mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over 3 months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% over 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (below 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 0.5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a combination of rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals increased consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a high federal funds rate (above 4%) during a period of economic expansion signals a potential slowdown in growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with high interest rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met during an economic expansion.
